phase: before broad sweeps; preliminary 3-trait stable pilot used only for runtime/positivity

hypotheses.prediction: Exogenous equal adult/private accuracy makes fixed d neutral; useful advice gives monotone mortality effect
Endorsed testimony accumulation can increase adult contrary-evidence persistence, with effect attenuated by public-only internalization control
Endogenous adult testimony creates an adaptation lag after environmental reversal; oracle benchmark removes immediate trust errors, RL may lag
Confidence-depth sensitivity can distinguish a repeated-evidence mechanism from a discrete choice artifact; effects must survive H=3,6,9 and step halving
Maturation transfers private belief distribution and may create a tau optimum without direct tau fecundity reward; reset-at-maturation must remove this channel
Resident culture may shift the invasion optimum away from isolated abundance optimum, or may show no difference
Alternative initial cultures may persist as different attractors; failed convergence to distinct states is a negative result

grid_main: 17 deference x19 log tau [.5,12], models fixed/public_only/memoryless/private/oracle/rl; stable, shock, periodic, wrong_history, no_payoff
refinement: 33x37 fixed stable and shock (preselected, not tuned for desired sign)
stochastic: 20 exploratory environment seeds and 20 independent confirmatory seeds at matched d=0,.5,1 and tau=1,3,8; shared environmental histories across traits
scope_limit: No full cooperation norm game; social sanctions, private/public second-order beliefs and parent-offspring conflict remain untested. No novel mechanism assumed.
